# llm-budget-exhaustion-causes-run-failure

If the semantic extractor raises LLMBudgetExceeded, the code translates this into a CompileError which fails the compile run; this makes runs vulnerable to LLM-budget limits and causes resumed/follow-up runs to be necessary to complete work.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._extract_semantic`
